guardian.title: Strength training for your teen.
guardian.subtitle: For ages 15 to 17. You hold the agreement and give consent. Your teen gets their own login and gives their own consent.
guardian.inviteIntro: Your teen gets an e-mail with the invitation. No account is created until they have read it and said yes themselves.
guardian.birthDateHint: MakeIt Ung is for ages 15 to 17. The date of birth is not shown to anyone else.
guardian.consentTraining: Training and technique are always included. That is the product.
guardian.consentRecovery: Sleep and recovery (from a watch or ring, if your teen connects one)
guardian.consentMind: Mind: check-in and a private journal
guardian.alertBody: You are told automatically if the app sees signs that training is taking up too much room: training on 12 or more of 14 days, or several sessions on the same day again and again for at least a week. At signs of self-harm you are told at once. The young person sees every message you get. You never see their journal, messages or check-in answers.
guardian.declaration: I am 18 or older and hold parental responsibility for this teen
guardian.effective: In effect now (both said yes): sleep and recovery {recovery} · Mind {mind}
guardian.endBody: Your teen's account and all data are deleted. This cannot be undone.
guardian.withdrawBody: The link in the e-mail stops working.

errors.form: Check the fields and the declaration, and try again.
errors.age: MakeIt Ung is for ages 15 to 17. Check the date of birth.
errors.exists: That e-mail already has an account. Use another.
errors.open: There is already an open invitation to that e-mail.

invite.title: Hi {name}. {guardian} has invited you.
invite.intro: Read this before you say yes. It takes two minutes.
invite.inTraining: Training programmes, technique and cues for every exercise.
invite.inRecovery: Sleep and recovery, if you connect a watch or ring.
invite.inFood: Ideas for food around training, without calories and without weight.
invite.inMind: Mind: a short check-in and a journal only you can read.
invite.outBody: There is no calorie counter, no weight and no goals for your body. That is on purpose.
invite.alertAcute: If you write something suggesting you want to hurt yourself, your parent is told immediately, and you see Børnetelefonen, headspace and 112.
invite.alertConcern: If for at least 7 days the app sees signs that training is taking up too much room, meaning training on 12 or more of 14 days, or several sessions on the same day again and again, your parent gets one neutral message about what we saw.
invite.alertSeen: You see every message your parent gets. Your parent never sees your journal, your messages or your answers.
invite.guardianSaidNoRecovery: Sleep and recovery are not included, because your parent said no.
invite.guardianSaidNoMind: Mind is not included, because your parent said no.
invite.consent: I have read what MakeIt Ung is and when my parent is told, and I say yes myself
invite.help: Need someone to talk to? Børnetelefonen 116 111 · headspace.dk · emergency 112
invite.invalidBody: It may have been used, withdrawn or expired. Ask your parent to send a new one.

errors.form: Check your password and the box, and try again.
errors.invalid: The invitation no longer works. Ask your parent for a new one.
errors.exists: An account with that e-mail already exists.

today.title: Hi {name}.
today.sessionHint: Pick a weight you could do two or three more reps with. Technique first.
today.chooseBody: Start with Grundstyrke: three days a week, technique first, no max attempts.
today.restBody: No session today. Rest is part of training.
today.foodBody: What and when to eat when you train. No numbers.
today.mindBody: How are you today? Takes a minute.

food.title: Food around training.
food.subtitle: Your body is growing and training at the same time. It needs enough food, spread over the day.

regular.title: Eat regularly
regular.body: Three meals and a couple of snacks give energy for both school and training. Don't skip meals to train.
regular.examples: Breakfast, lunch, dinner and something in the afternoon.

before.title: Before training
before.body: A meal 2 to 3 hours before, or something light an hour before, so you have energy.
before.examples: Rye bread with cheese, a banana, yoghurt with muesli.

after.title: After training
after.body: Eat within a couple of hours. Your body builds after training and needs food for it.
after.examples: Dinner, a roll with a topping, oats with milk.

drink.title: Drink water
drink.body: Drink water through the day and during training, especially when it's warm.
drink.examples: A water bottle in your bag is enough.

plate.title: A good plate
plate.body: Something filling, something with protein and something green. All kinds of food can be part of it.
plate.examples: Potatoes, pasta or rice · meat, fish, eggs or beans · vegetables or fruit.

food.footer: If you're unsure about food or energy, talk to your parents, your school nurse or your doctor.

notices.crisis_language: {name} has written something in their MakeIt journal that may be about self-harm or about not wanting to be here. We do not show what it says.
notices.daily_training: {name} has trained on {trainedDays} of the last {windowDays} days.
notices.double_sessions: {name} has trained two or more times on the same day on {doubleDays} of the last {windowDays} days.
notices.acuteNext: Talk with {name} today, calmly and without pressure. If there is immediate danger, call 112. Børnetelefonen (116 111), headspace.dk and your own doctor can also help. {name} has been shown the same numbers in the app.
notices.concernNext: This is not a diagnosis, only what the app has seen. Have a calm talk about how much room training takes up. If you are worried, talk to your own doctor or to LMS, the Danish association against eating disorders and self-harm (lms.dk).
notices.seenByYouth: {name} sees the same message in the app.
notices.why: You receive this because you gave consent to MakeIt Ung for {name}. You can end it at any time at {url}.
notices.youthTitle: We have sent your parent this message
notices.youthBody: You have not done anything wrong. We tell you so nothing happens behind your back.
notices.youthHelp: Want to talk to someone? Børnetelefonen 116 111 (day and night) · headspace.dk · emergency 112
notices.listEmpty: No messages. You get an e-mail if the app sees one of the signs.
